channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: Blithe Spirit: Theatre 98 (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Thu to Sun through 11/1 · 7:30 PM Thu to Sat, 2:30 PM Sun | Theatre 98, Fairhope | from $20. Noël Coward's classic ghost comedy plays at Theatre 98, Fairhope's intimate community playhouse. The remaining shows run Thursday 10/29 to Sunday 11/1, which makes it an easy dressed-up date night.

item.title: Carnival of the Animals: Ballet Pensacola (Foo Foo Fest) (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Sun 11/1, Mon 11/2, Tue 11/3 · see showtimes | The Clark Family Cultural Center | No published price. Carnival of the Animals is an original family ballet set to Saint-Saens's score, danced by Ballet Pensacola's Student Company and Youth Ensemble. Animal puppets and projections tell the story of a child's dream, and the show ends with an interactive Parade of Animals with friends of the Humane Society. It is part of the Foo Foo Festival and is made for audiences of every age.

item.title: Cat-puccinos and Cosplay HizashiCon charity brunch (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Sunday 11/1 · 9:30 AM to 10:45 AM · 11:15 AM to 12:30 PM | Coastal Cat Cafe | from $60. Coastal Cat Cafe hosts a charity brunch before HizashiCon with coffee, snacks and a lounge full of 20 or more adoptable cats. Guests can come in costume or as they are, and the cafe is decorated for Halloween weekend. Of each $60 ticket, $15 goes to the cafe's rescue partners. The brunch has two sessions, 9:30 AM to 10:45 AM and 11:15 AM to 12:30 PM.

item.title: Delta Discovery cruise from Five Rivers (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Saturday 10/31 · 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM · Sunday 11/1 · 1:30 PM | Bartram dock, Five Rivers Delta Resource Center | from $15. Historic Blakeley State Park runs 90-minute boat trips into the Mobile-Tensaw Delta, which the park calls the American Amazon. The boats leave from the Bartram dock at the AWF Delta and Bay Conservation Center at Five Rivers. The park lists two departures on Saturday, October 31, at 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM, and one on Sunday, November 1, at 1:30 PM.

item.title: Delta Reign Pre-Release at Trinity Games (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Sunday 11/1 · start time not posted · SOLD OUT | Trinity Games | from $30. Trinity Games runs the Pokémon TCG Mega Evolution Delta Reign pre-release tournament on Sunday, November 1. Entry is $30 and includes a ready-to-play 40-card deck, four booster packs, a stamped promo card and a digital code card. Play is Swiss with random pairings. The shop's page showed the November 1 date as sold out on 10/28.

item.title: Elevate Relationship Workshop at the Fort Walton Beach Library (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Friday 10/30 · 6:00 PM · Saturday 10/31 · 9:00 AM · Saturday 11/7 · 9:00 AM | Fort Walton Beach Library | No published price. Healthy Relationships Emerald Coast returns to the Fort Walton Beach Library with a three-day Elevate Relationship Workshop for adults. Sessions run Friday October 30 from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM, Saturday October 31 from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM and Saturday November 7 from 9:00 AM to 1:30 PM. Lunch is provided on November 7.

item.title: Foo Foo Festival (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Thu 10/29 to Mon 11/9 | Downtown Pensacola | No published price. Foo Foo Festival runs across downtown Pensacola from October 29 through November 9, one of the destination's own signature annual events. Visit Pensacola's page for it doesn't spell out a program, since it covers many venues under one banner.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Saturdays (college football) and Sundays (NFL), plus select Monday and Thursday nights | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Greater Gulf State Fair (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Oct 30 to Nov 8 · Weekdays 4 PM · Weekends 12 PM | Greater Gulf State Fairgrounds | No published price. The Greater Gulf State Fair fills the Mobile fairgrounds for ten days with a midway of rides, a rodeo, a community stage and a pickin porch. It is the largest fair in the Mobile area and a good outing for a family that wants a full evening of rides and fair food. Children 4 and under do not need an admission ticket, though they do need a wristband to ride. General admission and ride prices are not printed on the fair's pages, so check the ticket store before driving over.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (SUN 11/1)
item.description: During library hours through 11/1 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. It hangs all day during the library's own hours through November 1, so call the library to confirm them before you go.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit 2026 (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Nov 1 to Dec 15 · all day during branch hours, closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. More than fifty paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 who attend local public schools interpret jazz music at the Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library. The JAWS Festival put the exhibit together with the Mobile Arts Council and the Amp Up Arts Program, and it hangs from November 1 through December 15 during branch hours, which are Monday to Saturday.

item.title: Last Rites vampire night at Downtown Music Hall (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Saturday 10/31 · 10:00 PM to 3:00 AM | Downtown Music Hall | from $20. Downtown Music Hall stays open until 3 AM on Halloween for a vampire-themed night of goth, industrial and darkwave DJs, with DJ Chubby, DJ Interface and DJ Meduxa. Expect blood bags, specialty cocktails, a costume contest and photo spots. It is 18 and over, and gothic or dark formal dress is encouraged.

item.title: Lightspill (mirrored-sphere art installation) (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Thursday 10/29 to Monday 11/9 · times not posted | Artel Gallery | Free. Lightspill is a large temporary public art installation by Friends of Downtown on the front of the historic Artel Gallery building in downtown Pensacola. Hundreds of mirrored spheres appear to pour over the facade, and the look changes through the day with light and weather. It's free and open to the public, from October 29 to November 9, as part of Foo Foo Festival.

item.title: Mobile in the Gilded Age exhibition at the History Museum of Mobile (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM · through 6/6/2027 | History Museum of Mobile | from $8. The History Museum of Mobile opened Mobile in the Gilded Age on October 9, 2026, and the exhibition stays up through June 6, 2027. Gowns, inventions and everyday objects show how railroads, new technology and department stores changed life in Mobile in the late 1800s and early 1900s. The exhibition also covers the unequal opportunities and segregation of the period.

item.title: Mobile Music Legends exhibit at Moorer Branch Library (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Library hours · 11/1 to 12/15 · closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. The Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library hosts the first annual Mobile Music Legends exhibit. The display celebrates artists and ensembles who carried the soul, jazz and spirit of the Gulf Coast to the world. The exhibit stays up from November 1 to December 15.

item.title: Neal Francis with Sam Fribush Trio at Laguna's (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Sunday 11/1 · doors 6:00 PM, show 7:30 PM | Laguna's Adventure Park (Tiki Deck) | No published price. Neal Francis plays the Tiki Deck at Laguna's on Pensacola Beach, with the Sam Fribush Trio opening. He is touring his album Return To Zero, a mix of rock and 1970s dance music. Night Moves Pensacola, Foo Foo Fest and Floored present the show.

item.title: Night Moves Music Fest (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Thursday 10/29 to Sunday 11/8 · times vary by show | The Handlebar, Lagunas, Odd Colony, Betty's and more | No published price. Night Moves is a multi-venue music festival across Pensacola for eleven days, covering indie and alternative, punk, EDM and singer-songwriter shows. Venues named include The Handlebar, Lagunas, Odd Colony and Betty's. Individual shows at The Handlebar are listed as all ages at $20 to $25, with doors at 6 PM and music at 7 PM.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Pensacola Interstate Fair (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Oct 22 to Nov 1 | Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds | from $7.24. Eleven days of rides, livestock barns and fried everything at the fairgrounds off Mobile Highway. Gate admission is $16.06 for adults and $7.24 for children 4 to 11, and children 3 and under are free.

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center, November sessions (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Nov 1 to Nov 25 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions. The November sessions run Sunday 11/1 at 6:30 PM, Saturday 11/7 and Sunday 11/8 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Friday 11/13 and Saturday 11/14 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 11/15 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Wednesday 11/25 at 9:30 PM. The Bay Center states that all sessions are subject to change.

item.title: Science on the Street (sound and music science) (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Thursday 10/29 to Sunday 11/8 · Sound Booth Fri 10/30 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM, Sun 11/1 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM, Sat 11/7 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM and 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM | Palafox Street between Garden and Main | Free. Science on the Street is a self-guided, hands-on look at the science of sound on Palafox Street between Garden and Main in Pensacola, from October 29 to November 8. It has oversized instruments, tuning forks, sound-wave displays and acoustics demonstrations. The Pensacola MESS Hall runs it as part of Foo Foo Festival, and it's free.

item.title: Side Show (musical, PenArts) (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Friday 10/30 7:30 PM · Sunday 11/1 2:30 PM · Tuesday 11/3 to Saturday 11/7 7:30 PM · Sunday 11/8 2:30 PM (SOLD OUT) | The Gordon Community Art Center | from $20. Side Show is a musical staged by PenArts at The Gordon Community Art Center in Pensacola, about conjoined twins who became vaudeville stars. It plays Friday, October 30 through Sunday, November 8, with 7:30 PM evening shows and 2:30 PM Sunday matinees, and the Sunday, November 8 matinee is sold out. It suits elementary-school ages and up. Free outdoor attractions run before each show outside the venue. Tickets are $20.

item.title: Sunday Funniez Comedy Showcase (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Sunday 11/1 · 6:00 PM (doors 5:00 PM) | Crescent Theater | No published price. The Crescent Theater on Dauphin Street hosts the Sunday Funniez Comedy Showcase, a stand-up night for adults. The theater's page lists the show for ages 18 and up and gives no lineup, so the comics are a surprise. Doors open an hour before the 6:00 PM start.

item.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Fri 10/23 to Sun 11/1 · Fri and Sat 7:30 PM, Sun 2:30 PM | Pensacola State College, Ashmore Auditorium, Building 8 | from $7. Pensacola State College stages Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street in Ashmore Auditorium over two weekends, October 23 to 25 and October 30 to November 1. The college describes the eight-time Tony Award winning musical as a thriller about an exiled barber who seeks revenge on a corrupt system of justice. One performance falls on Halloween night.

item.title: Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Fridays 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM · Saturdays 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM · Sundays 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM through 11/1 | Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction | from $25. Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction runs an indoor haunted house at 811 St Francis St in downtown Mobile on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights through Sunday, November 1. Guests walk through dark mazes with live scare actors, and optional Blackout and Chamber mini escape games cost extra. The attraction warns it may be too intense for younger children, and every child must be accompanied by an adult.

item.title: Taste of the Beach: Pensacola Beach (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Oct 29-Nov 1 · Sat daytime = the family window | Casino Beach / beach venues | Free. Saturday is the daylong event at Casino Beach, with cooking demonstrations, challenges and tastings from more than a dozen beach restaurants, and sand for the kids between plates. Thursday opens the weekend with a sunset cruise, Friday is a VIP trolley dinner and Sunday closes with a trolley brunch. Those three are ticketed separately.

item.title: The View Within exhibition at Blue Morning Gallery (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Sunday 10/25 to Saturday 11/28 · reception Friday 11/6 at 4:30 | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Blue Morning Gallery in downtown Pensacola shows The View Within, an exhibition of colorful abstract paintings by the featured artist, from October 25 through November 28. A reception on Friday November 6 at 4:30 lets visitors meet the artist, hear live music and enjoy refreshments and conversation.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: 10th Annual Bras Across the CAUSEway 5K & Fun Run (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Sunday 11/1 · 5K and 1-mile fun run 7:30 AM (moved from Sat 10/10) | USS ALABAMA Battleship Memorial Park | from $35. The 10th annual Bras Across the CAUSEway moved to Sunday, November 1, at USS Alabama Battleship Memorial Park because of Isaias, with a 5K, a festival and a Sunday service. It offers a timed 5K and a family-friendly 1-mile fun run, both at 7:30 AM, with a virtual option too, and raises money for local breast-cancer patients. Registration is $40 for ages 13 and up and $35 for 12 and under through October 31, and parking is $5 per vehicle.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Gatalop 42 Renaissance Festival (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Friday 10/30 to Sunday 11/1 · 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM daily | Historic Fort Gaines | No published price. Costumed performers stage a Renaissance-fair-style weekend inside the walls of Historic Fort Gaines on Dauphin Island. Mobile County's listing does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Aminah Robinson: Journeys Home at the Mobile Museum of Art (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 1/9 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Aminah Robinson: Journeys Home is a special exhibition at the Mobile Museum of Art that draws on the artist's historical research, folklore and personal narrative. The museum describes it as a visual memoir of her life and a tableau of the African American experience. It stays open through January 9, 2027.

item.title: Gateway: From Graffiti to Gallery at the Mobile Museum of Art (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Wednesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, through 9/1/2027 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. The Mobile Museum of Art traces how artists who started with graffiti in New York's subways moved into galleries, with work by Basquiat, Haring, Scharf, KAWS and Banksy from the Masterworks Foundation collection. The show runs a full year, Wednesday through Saturday. Mobile County residents get in free on Thursdays.

item.title: Greater Gulf Artisan Showcase (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Friday 10/30 to Sunday 11/1 · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM daily | The Grounds | Free. Local artists, artisans and makers fill The Grounds in Mobile for a three-day market of original artwork, jewelry, home decor, textiles, ceramics and prints. There are live art demonstrations and local food vendors. Admission is free all three days.

item.title: Handle with Care at the Mobile Museum of Art (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 3/27 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Handle with Care is an interactive special exhibition at the Mobile Museum of Art. Artists Calder Kamin of Austin and Jacob Reptile of New Orleans turn trash into soft, complex sculptures that visitors move through as an environment. It stays open through March 27, 2027.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free.

item.title: Timeless Hats by Susie Mae Pugh-Williams at the Mobile Museum of Art (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 1/30 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Timeless Hats is a special exhibition of more than two dozen hats at the Mobile Museum of Art. Some were made by Mrs. Williams, and others are hats she admired and drew inspiration from for her own creations. It stays open through January 30, 2027.

item.title: Decorate with Us at Quayside Art Gallery (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Daily through 11/16 · 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Quayside Art Gallery | No published price. Quayside Art Gallery in Pensacola's historic district turns its first floor into a set of home style living spaces to show how local art fits a room. The show highlights all of the gallery's artists, with work ranging from large paintings and photography to pottery, glass, jewelry and wooden inlaid furniture. It is aimed at decorators, designers, realtors and condo owners, though anyone can walk in.

item.title: One Hopeful Place Chili Cook-Off (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Sunday 11/1 · 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM | Lou's Tavern | from $10. Local cooks compete for first, second and third place while guests taste the chilis and vote. Proceeds support One Hopeful Place and the people it serves. The page does not say whether children are welcome, so call before bringing them.

item.title: Coastal Makers grand opening party (SUN 11/1)
item.description: Sunday 11/1 · 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM | Coastal Makers | Free. Coastal Makers celebrates the opening of its 5,000 square foot creative studio in downtown Mobile. The party has free crafts and hands-on experiences, food, giveaways and a chance to meet the artists who teach there. Grand opening membership specials are also offered.
